caption: The drawing depicts an open fabric pouch or wallet with three visible interior compartments. The inside lining is pink, bordered and divided by olive green bands. The outer flap and sides are also pink with green edging. The bottom, front section of the pouch features a decorative panel with embroidery, consisting of a blue background adorned with floral motifs in shades of pink, yellow, white, and green. Above the floral section, there is a narrow, black band with a light-colored, stitched inscription or lettering, and what appears to be a date, “1734.” The entire composition is rendered with careful attention to the textures and colors of the fabric and embroidery. The background is plain and light, with no additional elements present.
title: Purse
